title: Kyiv day and night - Series 11 - Season 4
description: Series 11 4 seasons Kyiv day and night begins with the fact that Pasha deceives Karina's expectations and ... invites her to a date. By the way, he accepts the proposal of Andrei Borisovich, becomes the manager of the Patibus. Epifanio wants to fire Nastya, but Oksana is trying to stop him. Arthur is sewing the case with Max's filing, he faces six years in prison. Nastya is going to leave Kyiv, Bogdan wants with her.  Arthur is waiting for a surprise, it is released from the camera. Moreover, he gets a job. Olezhka brings Sasha to a performance from which he runs in two minutes. Rita and Christina run away from home, Yana is going to the police. Pasha arranges for Karina a superweeter.  Kyiv day and night - series, a format that is being implemented in Ukraine for the first time. It combines the drama of the series and life stories. If easier, this is a series that unfolds in real time with real people. Heroes are not actors, but ordinary guys who find themselves in the situations set by the script and show their natural, genuine emotions in them. There is a situation. And what will happen next, no one knows. It all depends on the mood and perception of the heroes. On September 19, 2017, the fourth season of the series started ..  New Channel - Let's live at once!
